thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High GPU queue length detected on pool gpu-prod-eu-west. queue_length=1824, avg_wait=18.4s, autoscaler_attempts=+10 -> accepted=+2. PagerDuty P12345 triggered.

maria: I'm paged, looking. pulling autoscaler and node logs now.

lee: seeing repeated CUDA/Xid errors in dmesg on gpu-node-3 and gpu-node-7: "NVRM: Xid (79) 00000000..." plus multiple kernel OOM events. nodes are flapping driver restart loop.

alice: customer impact? which routes are impacted?

jon: /v1/generate is showing 5xx and long tail latency. top callers: chat-bot-app, embed-search. backlog per route: chat-bot-app=920, embed-search=540. overall backlog ~1.8k.

sam: tried manual scale (+6) but kube rejected new nodes due to taint: "nvidia-driver-failed=true:NoSchedule". driver pod crashloop on provisioned nodes.

maria: quick mitigation plan (1) temporarily disable autoscaler adds to avoid more tainted nodes (2) drain and cordon clearly failing nodes (3) split traffic to us-east fallback pool (4) lower inference batch_size and fallback to quantized variant for eu-west routes.

lee: running drain on most obvious offender.
```bash
kubectl drain gpu-node-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
kubectl cordon gpu-node-7
```

incident-bot: Deploy job queued: driver-hot-restart on gpu-node-7 (job id job-9876). logs: "GPU memory allocation failed: OutOfMemory" then Xid 79 reported.

alice: i'll notify CS and draft a status page blurb. do we have a list of affected customers?

jon: quick list: acme-inc (high errors on embed routes), beta-saas (degraded latency), internal-dev (timeouts). sending to CS now.

sam: trying a config-level mitigation: reduce default batch_size to 8 and lower max_inflight to 500 for eu-west. applying policy change.

maria: applying traffic split to move 30% of /v1/generate to us-east fallback pool. command: 
```bash
redwood route update --route /v1/generate --split eu-west=0.7,us-east=0.3
```

sam: split applied. monitoring. backlog dropping: 1800 -> 920 -> 610 within 4m.

lee: driver restarts still happening on two nodes, kernel logs show "NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus" then dmesg Xen/Xid chain. appears correlated with a recent driver build.

maria: do we have capacity to move more to us-east or dedicated pools? need to avoid EU customer SLA misses.

jon: we have ~40% spare capacity in us-east dedicated pool and some reserved nodes in dedicated-eu that are currently idle. can shift additional 20% quickly.

alice: CS update posted to customers: "We're experiencing elevated request latency and throttling in eu-west due to GPU driver instability; traffic is partially rerouted and mitigation is in progress. We'll share updates every 30 minutes." (link to status page draft).

incident-bot: Note: autoscaler disabled for pool gpu-prod-eu-west by maria at 3456789020.

sam: applied hotpatch attempt to driver on gpu-node-3 and gpu-node-7, but two nodes still show kernel panic on load. fallback: enable eviction of large KV caches and switch model to quantized-64 to reduce GPU memory pressure.

maria: commands to change model fallback policy: 
```bash
redwood model update --route /v1/generate --fallback quantized-64 --batch_size 8
```

lee: applied fallback. memory pressure decreased, driver failures reduced on restarted nodes. backlog now ~350. We should consider rolling back recent driver package to previous stable version clusterwide. coordinating with infra.

alice: CS: updated customers (acme-inc, beta-saas) with mitigation steps and estimated ETA 1h. created ticket CS-4421 for escalation.

pagerduty-bot: Oncall handoff scheduled in 40s. current oncall: maria, next oncall: lee.

maria: handoff notes — drained nodes: gpu-node-7,gpu-node-3; autoscaler disabled; traffic split eu-west=0.6,us-east=0.4 (increased); fallback model quantized-64 enabled for /v1/generate; customers notified (CS-4421). ongoing: one node (gpu-node-2) still intermittently failing on stress >90% mem. logs and core dumps saved at s3://redwood-incident-dumps/3456789012/.

lee: i'm taking over. plan: (A) coordinate infra to rollback driver to v470.57 on all eu-west nodes (B) if rollback not possible quickly, continue traffic migration and increase dedicated us-east capacity (C) review kernel logs and open bug with vendor if Xid persists. pinging @infra-team now.

jon: monitoring alert: queue_length eu-west=320, us-east intake=+35% of traffic. setting 30m watch. will escalate if queue growth >500.

maria: thanks everyone — handing off. please keep thread updated. :thumbsup:

lee: acknowledged, will keep updates here. taking ownership. :pager:
